title: Smoky British Chickpeas Scones Clotted Cream
description: A smoky, chewy, indulgent British dish featuring hummus and robata-grilled chickpeas, served with clotted cream in a scone format, low-fat-friendly and delicious.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the self-raising flour, smoked paprika, salt, and baking powder.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and hummus until smooth.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Fold in the chickpeas and knead the dough gently until they are evenly distributed.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each into a round scone.
Brush the tops of the scones with robata-grill oil and place them on the preheated grill.
Grill the scones for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and cooked through.
Serve the scones warm with clotted cream and a side of additional hummus if desired.
